import sys
import math

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.stream = stream
        self.buf = bytearray(1024)
        self.ptr = 0
        self.len = 0

    def read(self):
        if self.len == -1:
            raise RuntimeError()
        if self.ptr >= self.len:
            self.ptr = 0
            try:
                self.len = self.stream.readinto(self.buf)
            except Exception:
                raise RuntimeError()
            if self.len <= 0:
                return -1
        res = self.buf[self.ptr]
        self.ptr += 1
        return res

    def nextInt(self):
        c = self.read()
        while c <= 32:
            c = self.read()
        sign = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sign = -1
            c = self.read()
        val = 0
        while c > 32:
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                raise RuntimeError()
            val = val * 10 + c - ord('0')
            c = self.read()
        return val * sign


def convolve(a, b, mod):
    len_a = len(a)
    len_b = len(b)
    result_len = len_a + len_b - 1
    
    n = 1
    while n < result_len:
        n <<= 1

    ar = [0.0] * n
    ai = [0.0] * n
    br = [0.0] * n
    bi = [0.0] * n

    for i in range(len_a):
        x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        ai[i] = x >> 15

    for i in range(len_b):
        x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF
        bi[i] = x >> 15

    transform(ar, ai, False)
    transform(br, bi, False)

    cr1 = [0.0] * n
    ci1 = [0.0] * n
    cr2 = [0.0] * n
    ci2 = [0.0] * n

    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5

        b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5

        cr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        ci1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        cr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        ci2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

    transform(cr1, ci1, True)
    transform(cr2, ci2, True)

    res = [0] * result_len
    for i in range(result_len):
        aa = round(cr1[i])
        bb = round(cr2[i])
        cc = round(ci1[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return res


def transform(re, im, inverse):
    n = len(re)
    bits = 32 - (n - 1).bit_length()
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(bits)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]

    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                angle = 2 * math.pi * j / length
                wRe = math.cos(angle)
                wIm = -math.sin(angle) if inverse else math.sin(angle)

                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe

                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm
        length <<= 1

    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n


def main():
    in_reader = InputReader(sys.stdin.buffer)
    out = sys.stdout
    n = in_reader.nextInt()
    k = in_reader.nextInt()
    v = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        v[in_reader.nextInt()] = 1
    
    result = [1]
    exponent = n // 2
    while exponent > 0:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = convolve(result, v, 998244353)
        v = convolve(v, v, 998244353)
        exponent >>= 1
    
    total = 0
    for val in result:
        total = (total + val * val) % 998244353
    out.write(str(total) + '\n')
    out.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
